units.source_text: 6月30日，我又一次去千本金出川，买了夹馅面包和豆馅糯米饼。

en.t: On June 30, I went once more to Senbon Imadegawa and bought filled buns and bean paste rice cakes.

units.source_text: 寺庙不供零食，我曾用少得可怜的零花钱，在那里多次买过一些点心。

en.t: The temple provided no snacks, and I had often used my pitifully small allowance to buy sweets there.
